images.title: Two lines in fifths
images.purpose: Show two lengths read in fifths by counting gaps from 0: a line over 2 gaps is 2/5 and a line over 4 gaps is 4/5.
images.composition: One number line along the bottom, with two thick lines stacked above it, both starting at 0, and generous space between the rows.
images.exact_structure: A grey #6B7280 number line from 0 to 2 with exactly 11 evenly spaced ticks: each unit cut into 5 equal gaps. Above it, two thick horizontal lines both starting exactly above 0. Lower one, teal #0072B2, ends exactly above the 2nd tick after 0. Upper one, amber #E69F00, ends exactly above the 4th tick after 0. Thin grey dotted guides drop from each line's end to its tick. Exactly 1 number line, 2 stacked lines.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
stacked lines that do not start exactly above 0
images.takeaway: Count the gaps from 0: 2 gaps is 2/5 and 4 gaps is 4/5.
images.description: A number line from 0 to 2 in fifths; above it a teal line from 0 over 2 gaps labelled 2/5 and an amber line from 0 over 4 gaps labelled 4/5.
images.context: Shown with the concept as its one key picture, next to the walkthrough video. PLACEHOLDER: specified, not generated yet.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to count the gaps under each line from 0 and say both lengths aloud.

image_decisions.why: Two lengths on one fifths number line compare cleanly in a single stacked picture.
